title: Outdoor living area within the primary street setback area
text: C1.1.2 Notwithstanding C1.1.1, a single consolidated outdoor living area may be located within the primary street setback area where any street walls or fences within the primary street setback area are visually permeable in accordance with C3.6.5 and C3.6.6.

replaces.note: current DTC requires OLA behind the street setback; front-setback OLA only via P1.3

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Applies only where the OLA is located in the primary street setback area (rule condition); then any street walls or fences in that area must be visually permeable per C3.6.5 and C3.6.6. The same test is the exception on C1.1.1-r3. 'Single consolidated' is not tested (no fact). Pink note: Information Sheet 3 survey seeks feedback on POS structure and metrics, so this may change.
